# Simvay S-mark logo - data URIs (206x256 PNG, transparent background)

Regenerated 2026-07-20 from the logo embedded in HaloPSA PDF template 32.
Teal mark re-derived 2026-09-09 from the white mark (same alpha, fill #00627B) during the brain migration; the original teal base64 did not survive transcription.
Usage rules in `runbooks/simvay-document-brand-guide.md` §4. To use in HTML:
`<img alt="Simvay" src="...uri...">`. To write out as a .png file, strip the
`data:image/png;base64,` prefix and base64-decode the rest.
